name: Preview
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'Branch or commit to test on the separate demo-only preview Worker'
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: preview
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    environment: preview
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      CF_PREVIEW_D1_ID: ${{ vars.CF_PREVIEW_D1_ID }}
      CF_PRODUCTION_D1_ID: ${{ vars.CF_PRODUCTION_D1_ID }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ENV: preview
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ inputs.ref }}'}
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: 10.31.0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22.22.0', cache: pnpm}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm check
      - run: node scripts/configure-cloudflare.mjs preview
      - run: pnpm build
      - run: node scripts/local-qa.mjs
      - run: pnpm run deploy:preview
      # Only a maintainer runs this against trusted code. Use an independently
      # provisioned preview account/token and demo database; never production secrets.
